audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart hands Vayne Levels 1, 2 and 3 in both layers, while whys[0] in the same file says Vayne is among the weakest level-1s and Olaf wins first contact outright, and the packet chart says Olaf for rows 1 through 5.
audit.why: The page tells the player to survive an early game he actually dominates. Olaf is melee with a 1000-range slow and a ramping attack-speed passive; Vayne at 550 range with Silver Bolts needing three hits cannot win a Level 1-3 trade.
audit.corrected: Olaf wins Levels 1 through 6; Skill at first item; Vayne from two items on.

audit.why: Spikes are right in shape: Olaf at 2-3 and 6, Vayne at two-plus items where Silver Bolts' percent-max-health true damage (confirmed in Riot's text) and Final Hour's Tumble invisibility take over.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabrications. (a) 'the move speed toward her' is credited to Olaf's Ragnarok — Riot's text gives Ragnarok only armour, magic resist and disable immunity; move speed toward champions is Vayne's own passive, Night Hunter. (b) Olaf's W is described as omnivamp healing — Riot's text says attack speed and a shield; the life steal is on the passive, Berserker Rage.
audit.why: Both send the player into an all-in expecting stats he does not have. The real closing tool is Undertow's slow against a Tumble that is 6/5/4/3/2s, and Condemn at 20/18/16/14/12s.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok answers the Condemn stun; the axe slow, not phantom move speed, closes the Tumble gap. W is a shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is named everywhere but never numbered.
audit.why: 20s at rank 1 is a very long window for a melee champion with a 9s reset-on-pickup slow; that number is the whole reason the early all-in works.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the cooldown block and the Do's entry.

audit.why: 50.35% over 1275 games; the copy's early-strong, late-losing framing matches a coinflip overall.

edits.before: Q plus your ramping passive lets you stick her and out-trade a Vayne whose W bolts haven't stacked yet.
edits.after: Undertow plus your ramping passive sticks her before Silver Bolts reaches its third hit, and Condemn is 20s.

edits.before: Ragnarok cleanses her Condemn stun and the move speed toward her closes the tumble gap for the all-in.
edits.after: Ragnarok answers her Condemn stun and your axe slow closes the Tumble gap — this is your all-in window.

edits.before: Ragnarok cleanses her Condemn stun and the move speed toward her runs down her tumble — your cleanest all-in window of the game.
edits.after: Ragnarok answers Condemn's stun and axe slows run her down — Tumble is 6s at rank 1, so she cannot dash out of it twice.

edits.before: This is your takeover window. Pick your axe back up off the ground to refund Q and perma-slow her so she can never kite the trade, then E for the true-damage chunk while W-omnivamp heals you back up. At 6 your Ragnarok is the key: pop it as she Condemns and the CC immunity eats her stun, while the move speed toward her closes the tumble gap for a kill. Keep forcing these all-ins on her cooldowns — every short fight you take is a fight her ramping W loses.
edits.after: This is your takeover window. Pick the axe back up to refund Undertow's 9s cooldown and perma-slow her so she can never kite the trade, then Reckless Swing for the true-damage chunk while W's shield eats her return fire. At 6 Ragnarok is the key: press it as she Condemns and the disable immunity answers her stun, then chain axe slows onto a Tumble that is only 6s at rank 1. Keep forcing all-ins on her cooldowns — every short fight is one her ramping Silver Bolts loses.

edits.before: Wall-stun — but R ignores it. Stick to her. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — bait it, then Ragnarok through the stun and stick to her.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun — but R ignores it. Stick to her. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1, and a wall behind you turns it into a stun. Bait it, then commit. - Tumble: 6s at rank 1, 2s at rank 5. - Ragnarok: 100s — kill windows only.

notes: Level-chart flips are proposed as matched full/content pairs for rows 0-4 and land as one atomic group; rows 5 (Skill) and 6 (Vayne) already match the packet and were left alone. Ratings for the flipped rows were moved with them so the chart does not read 'Olaf wins, 2/10'. Whether Ragnarok's disable immunity also negates Condemn's knockback displacement (as opposed to only the wall stun) is not stated in Riot's text; the existing copy's claim was softened to 'answers the stun' rather than strengthened. The 'W-omnivamp' phrasing appears in several untouched fields (tradeGood, breakdown.trading, report[3], wants.foe[2]) and is inaccurate there too — W is a shield, the life steal is on the passive.
